messages.subject: Hartwell v Tessaract (CL-2026-000118) — proposed directions to CMC
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Mason,

Following service of the Defence today, please find attached our proposed directions to the CMC listed for 8 April 2026, together with a draft order and a specimen electronic disclosure index. We propose extended disclosure under PD 57AD (Models C and D), factual evidence by 28 August 2026, single-discipline expert evidence in analytical chemistry/GMP, and a 5-day trial window opening after 18 January 2027.

Grateful for your agreement or counter-proposals by 28 March 2026.

Yours faithfully,
Sarah Whitfield

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Hartwell v Tessaract (CL-2026-000118) — proposed directions to CMC
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you. We agree the directions in substance, subject to two points: (1) we say quantum requires separate expert accounting evidence on the clinical-delay head; and (2) we propose disclosure by 10 July rather than 26 June. We will also press for a mediation direction. We'll prepare a competing draft on those two points only.

Robert Mason
Thackeray Wolfe LLP
